# Sayida African Hair Braiding

> African hair braiding studio in North Greensboro, North Carolina: knotless, box, boho and micro braids, twists, cornrows, locs and men's styling. Open 7 days a week, 6 AM to 10 PM (Sundays 2 PM to 10 PM). Booked online on Square.

## Key facts
- Name: Sayida African Hair Braiding
- Type: hair braiding salon (private home studio, by appointment)
- Address: 5716 River Glen Dr, Greensboro, NC 27455 (North Greensboro)
- Phone: (336) 337-3257 (call or text)
- Book online (Square): https://book.squareup.com/appointments/ar1sv7kb7lxzov/location/L47ABMFSMWYT6/services
- Website: https://sayida-african-hair-braiding.netlify.app/
- Hours (Eastern time, from Square): Monday to Saturday 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM; Sunday 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM
- Booking lead time: at least 48 hours ahead on Square, up to 365 days ahead
- Rating: 4.6 stars from 240 Google reviews (October 2026)
- Area served: Greensboro and the Piedmont Triad, NC
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sayidaafricanhairbraiding/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Sayida-African-Hair-Braiding-100071119550419/

## Price list (Square, Oct 12, 2026; final price confirmed at booking)

### Braids
- Knotless Braids: Large: $185 (about 4 h); Medium: $200 (about 6 h 30 min); Small: $250 (about 8 h)
- Box Braids: Large: $185 (about 4 h); Medium: $210 (about 6 h 30 min); Small: $225 (about 8 h 30 min)
- Boho Braids: Large: $210 (about 4 h); Medium: $235 (about 6 h); Small: $265
- Micro Braids: Regular: $225 (about 6 h); Extra Small: $250 (about 8 h)

### Twists
- Boho Twists: Large: $210 (about 4 h); Medium: $235 (about 6 h); Small: $265 (about 7 h)
- Senegalese Twists: Medium: $210 (about 5 h); Small: $235 (about 6 h)
- Kinky Twists: Medium: $200 (about 5 h); Small: $220 (about 6 h)
- Marley Twists: $200 (about 5 h)
- Spring Twists: $185 (about 4 h)
- Mini Twists: $200 (about 6 h)

### Cornrows
- Cornrows: $65 (about 1 h 30 min)

### Locs
- Micro Locs: quote at consultation (about 3 h)
- Sister Locs: quote at consultation
- Original Locs: quote at consultation (about 2 h)

### Men
- Men's Styling: quote at consultation (about 30 min)

### Add-ons & consultations
- + Knotless (add-on): $30 (about 30 min)
- Consultation with Sayida: Custom Styling Consultation: free (about 30 min); Loc Consultation: free (about 30 min)

Loc services (micro, sister, original locs) and men's styling require a free 30-minute consultation with Sayida for a quote. Boho and twist styles can be made knotless with the +$30 add-on.

## FAQ
- Q: What are the hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 6 AM to 10 PM, Sunday 2 PM to 10 PM, by appointment.
- Q: How far ahead do I need to book?
  A: At least 48 hours ahead on Square. For sooner, call (336) 337-3257.
- Q: How much are knotless braids?
  A: Large $185 (about 4 h), medium $200 (about 6 h 30 min), small $250 (about 8 h).
- Q: How much are box braids?
  A: Large $185 (about 4 h), medium $210 (about 6 h 30 min), small $225 (about 8 h 30 min).
- Q: How much are cornrows?
  A: $65 for 3-layer cornrows, about 1 h 30 min.
- Q: Do they do locs?
  A: Yes: micro locs, sister locs and original locs, quoted at a free 30-minute consultation with Sayida.
- Q: How do I pay? Is hair included?
  A: Ask about payment options and whether hair is included for your style when you book.
- Q: Where is it?
  A: A private home studio at 5716 River Glen Dr, Greensboro, NC 27455.
